welcome.description: Hello, I'm Carlos Lores. I build frontend for high-traffic products: car search engines, savings simulators, e-commerce. Clean code, purposeful animation, and zero templates.

about.title: Who said frontend was just slicing designs?
about.paragraph1: I work on real products, not demos. I have developed pre-owned vehicle search engines for Lexus and Toyota, the savings and investment simulator for Mutua Madrileña, and digital components for El Corte Inglés. Real-traffic projects, real design, and punctual deadlines.
about.paragraph2: I trained at Ironhack and haven't stopped tinkering since: I revisited React and Angular in a daily basis, TypeScript whenever possible, and an almost obsessive focus on making things feel fast. If something takes more time than necessary, I take notice.

reasons.title: bulletproof layout
reasons.description: Grid, Flexbox, and container queries. If the designer changes their mind or the text doubles, the layout holds up. No hand-coded rigid pixels.

reasons.title: components, not pages
reasons.description: I think in systems. A well-built component is used twenty times and edited once. I come from large team projects where that makes all the difference.

reasons.title: performance from minute one
reasons.description: Bundle size under control, properly served images, and jank-free rendering. Performance isn't fixed at the end—it's decided at the start.

reasons.title: animation with a purpose
reasons.description: I love movement, but only when it explains something: where an element comes from, what just happened, where you are. Everything else is clutter.

contact.title: Get in touch with me
contact.description: I'm looking for a place where frontend is truly appreciated. If you have a project in mind or an open role, drop me a message and I'll be happy to talk about it.
